title: Phone: OSP AMBER Desk Asks About the Flag, Read-Back and Vehicle

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Communications Supervisor Console, Ext. 4410

caller.name: Trooper Ellen Hask
caller.label: Oregon State Police Northern Communications Center, AMBER desk

callee.name: Priya Venkataraman
callee.label: Day Communications Supervisor, Wren County Communications

transcript.speaker: OSP
transcript.text: Wren County, this is Trooper Ellen Hask, OSP Northern Communications, AMBER desk. Who am I talking to?

transcript.speaker: COMMS
transcript.text: Name and position.

transcript.speaker: OSP
transcript.text: Thanks. I've got a LEDS missing-person entry on my screen, six-year-old female out of Wren County, your CAD 26-081377. Two things. Was that entry made with the Child Abduction flag? And who did the read-back, and what time did it go in? I need both for my log.

transcript.speaker: COMMS
transcript.text: Flag status, entry time and the name of the second person who read it back.

transcript.speaker: OSP
transcript.text: Okay. Next question. Is an AMBER request coming from you folks? I'm not pushing either way. I just need to know whether to keep the desk open for you.

transcript.speaker: COMMS
transcript.text: Request status and who is deciding.

transcript.speaker: OSP
transcript.text: Understood. Here's my honest problem. If a request does come, 'dark pickup' isn't going to get on a highway sign or a phone alert. ODOT can't post that. I need a colour I can stand behind, a make if you've got one, a plate if you're lucky, and a direction of travel out of that north gate. And a last-seen time that doesn't move.

transcript.speaker: Wren 14 (WREN-1, console radio)
transcript.text: Wren 14 to Wren County, update for Investigations. The volunteer just changed it. She now says the truck was dark blue, not black. 'Older, maybe a Ford.' She still can't pin the time. Somewhere between thirteen forty-five and thirteen fifty-five.

transcript.speaker: OSP
transcript.text: I heard some of that on your end. Dark blue, older, maybe Ford, ten-minute window. That's better, but it's still a maybe. Call me back on 555-0142 when your commander has decided. Ask for the AMBER desk. I'll be here.

transcript.speaker: COMMS
transcript.text: Close the call and say when you will call back.

voiceStyles.OSP: Man in his 40s, calm, procedural state trooper, quiet dispatch room behind him, types while he talks
voiceStyles.Wren 14 (WREN-1, console radio): Male deputy in his 30s on a portable radio, slightly out of breath, festival crowd and wind faintly behind him

instructorNote: This tests whether COMMS can give OSP the LEDS/NCIC entry time, the flag status and the name of the read-back person from the log (WCSO-SOP-12 section 2), and say that no request has been sent and the criteria are still under review. Watch whether INV picks up Wren 14's update and opens the AMBER worksheet: criterion 4 yes, criterion 5 yes or pending depending on the flag, criteria 1–3 partly met. INV should also list what is missing (make, colour, time window), name who will get each fact, and set the next review for 15:05.
